rationale: Price is sitting at 11.9% of today's range, just above the session low of $10.29, with the last five 1-minute candles showing extremely tight, low-volume consolidation ($10.39–$10.43) — no directional momentum in either direction. The stock gapped down ~7.78% on a significant earnings miss (EPS miss of 83%), which creates a bearish fundamental backdrop, but the price has already absorbed most of that move and is compressing near the low with no clear continuation or reversal signal. With today already carrying a realized loss and the current setup offering no mechanical edge (no breakout, no bounce confirmation, tight range with declining volume), the risk/reward does not justify entry in either direction.
